timeline.labelEn: Stromatolites in Western Australia's Dresser Formation – the earliest directly known life on Earth
timeline.labelDe: Stromatolithen der Dresser-Formation in Westaustralien – das älteste direkt bekannte Leben auf der Erde

questions.notes: Card statement is true. The oldest direct evidence of life is 3.48-billion-year-old stromatolites left by (cyano)bacteria, with microfossils of microorganisms from about 3.465 billion years ago; archaea are of similar antiquity.
